name: Accordion
description: Items whose panels open and close under their heading — in the look of the app's style.

name: Alert
description: Displays important messages to the user.

name: Alert Dialog
description: A modal dialog for important alerts requiring confirmation.

name: Area Chart
description: Series as areas, filled down to 0 or stacked — to 100% if you like — with natural, linear, step or monotone edges; gradients of your own.

name: Aspect Ratio
description: Displays content within a fixed aspect ratio.

name: Attachment
description: Show a file alongside its upload state, on its own or in a scrollable row.

name: Audio Player
description: An audio player: a playlist, a waveform, controls as parts, state two ways, keyboard shortcuts.

name: Autocomplete
description: Free text with suggestions: the value is what is typed, a suggestion completes it; the Combobox’s parts.

name: Avatar
description: An image element with a fallback for representing users.

name: Backdrop
description: A dimmed, blurred layer that fades in and out behind an overlay.

name: Badge
description: Displays a small status indicator or label.

name: Bar Chart
description: Series as bars: side by side, stacked, below 0; rounded as the style rounds them (corners), coloured by series or by category; they grow in as they appear.

name: Barcode Scanner
description: Reads barcodes and QR codes from the camera or a picture, each code outlined where it is; with the browser's BarcodeDetector, or barcode-detector's where it has none.

name: Breadcrumb
description: Displays the path to the current resource.

name: Bubble
description: A single message in a conversation, aligned to either side and optionally carrying reactions.

name: Button
description: A native button for an action: six variants, eight sizes from the app's style, icons and a spinner; it submits a form only when told to.

name: Calendar
description: Days, months and years in your language; one, several or a range; the keyboard across months; a form field.

name: Card
description: A container for grouping related content.

name: Carousel
description: A slideshow for cycling through elements.

name: Chart
description: The parts every chart is made of, as shadcn/ui's: rows and series' names and colors, a plot with its grid, axes and cursor, a tooltip and a legend.

name: Checkbox
description: A native checkbox that draws itself, in the look of the app's style.

name: Checkbox Group
description: Checkboxes sharing one value, with an optional parent checkbox that ticks them all.

name: Code Block
description: Code to read and copy: highlighted, numbered, its lines marked.

name: Code Editor
description: Code to edit: CodeMirror, colored by Shiki; a form field.

name: Collapsible
description: A trigger that shows and hides a panel of content.

name: Color Picker
description: A color picker: area and channel sliders with alpha, any CSS colour in, swatches, hex/rgb/hsl/oklch out; a form field.

name: Combobox
description: A select to filter: an input over a list of options, one or several of which are its value.

name: Command
description: A search over commands: typing filters them, the arrows and Enter run them.

name: Compare
description: Two things compared, split by a divider: photos before and after, two themes, any content.

name: Confetti
description: A burst, two cannons or fireworks in the theme’s colours; canvas-confetti only where it is used.

name: Context Menu
description: A menu displayed on right-click.

name: Control Group
description: An input or a select joined with its buttons into one control: shared borders, outer corners rounded. shadcn’s Button Group.

name: Countdown
description: The time left to a moment, or a timer, its digits rolling: a Number Ticker for each unit, the time from Temporal.

name: Data Table
description: Styled, accessible parts for TanStack Table data tables.

name: Date Input
description: A date typed part by part, in the order of its locale: a number pad on a phone, a Temporal.PlainDate in a form, the day in a Date Picker.

name: Date Picker
description: A date picked in the calendar or typed, written in your language; a form field.

name: Date Range Input
description: A range of days typed in one box: your two Date Inputs, start and end; the field of a Date Range Picker.

name: Date Range Picker
description: A range of days picked in a calendar, typed, or a preset — its own part; Apply, and how long it is.

name: Date Time Input
description: A date and a time typed part by part, in the order and on the clock of its locale: a Temporal.PlainDateTime in a form.

name: Date Time Picker
description: A date and a time typed, or picked: the day in a calendar, the time in columns beside it, on the input's clock and limits.

name: Dialog
description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content.

name: Diff Viewer
description: Two texts compared, line by line and word by word: split or unified, highlighted.

name: Drawer
description: A panel at the edge of the screen that a swipe dismisses, with snap points and stacking — in the look of the app's style.

name: Editor
description: A rich text editor for articles, posts and notes, built on Tiptap: headings, lists and task lists, code blocks and links, with tables, images, search and replace and more as features you add. Its value is a Signal Forms field — HTML, JSON, Markdown or text — and its toolbar is yours, made of the library’s parts. For plain text, use a Textarea; for code, the Code Editor.

name: Emoji Picker
description: A picker for selecting emojis.

name: Empty
description: Placeholder for empty content.

name: Field
description: A flexible field composition system for building accessible forms.

name: File Input
description: Files picked, dropped or pasted — chosen, never uploaded — as a File[] for Signal Forms; those kept out, with every reason.

name: Focus Trap
description: A directive that keeps focus inside an element while it is shown, and gives it back when it goes.

name: Frame
description: A frame round a box — the style's card radius, ring and shadow — for an aspect ratio, a table, any box.

name: Funnel Chart
description: A series as stages, top to bottom, each as wide as its value, narrowing to the next.

name: Gantt
description: A Data Table with a timeline column: bars, progress, milestones, links, markers; dragged or moved from the keyboard.

name: Header
description: A site's top bar, the page's banner: your brand, the Navigation Menu's links and your actions; on narrow screens a toggle and a menu that covers the page below the bar. It can stay at the top, or slide away as the page scrolls. For an app's navigation beside the page, use a Sidebar.

name: Image Cropper
description: Crop an image: a box over it or a frame it moves under, the crop as two-way state, sliders for screen readers, cropImage() for the file.

name: Infinite Scroll
description: More near the end or the start, with whatever scrolls; a Load more button and a status.

name: Input
description: A native text field in the look of the app's style: in a Field it takes the label and description; with Signal Forms it shows itself invalid once touched.

name: Input Button
description: A button styled to look like an input field, useful as a trigger for search dialogs or command palettes.

name: Input Group
description: An input or a textarea with icons, text and buttons in one box: beside it, above or below; a click on an addon focuses the field.

name: Item
description: A flexible layout component for displaying structured content.

name: JSON Viewer
description: A JSON value as a tree: type-coloured values, objects and arrays that open and close, long arrays in ranges, copy.

name: Kanban Board
description: Your items by column, dragged by any pointer or moved by the keyboard: Sortable Lists, linked in a group.

name: Kbd
description: Displays keyboard shortcuts and keys.

name: Label
description: Renders an accessible label for form controls.

name: Lightbox
description: A gallery of links opened in the native dialog, the thumbnail morphing in; zoom, pan, swipes, keys.

name: Line Chart
description: Series as lines through their values: natural, linear, step or monotone; dots if you like.

name: Link
description: A styled anchor element with button variants.

name: Listbox
description: One option or several, chosen from a list always in view — the WAI-ARIA keyboard, ranges and typeahead; a form field.

name: Marker
description: Label a point in a list or feed: a date divider, an unread boundary, or a short inline note.

name: Marquee
description: Content written once and repeated to fill, speed in px/s, four directions, pauses for hover, focus and a button; still for reduced motion.

name: Masonry Grid
description: Columns by width, the source order kept, re-laid out on any size change, spans, animated moves; native where possible.

name: Menu
description: A menu of actions from a button: groups, checkbox and radio items, submenus, shortcuts — in the look of the app's style.

name: Menubar
description: A horizontal menu bar with keyboard navigation support.

name: Message
description: A row in a conversation: an avatar beside a column of bubbles, with an optional header and footer.

name: Message Scroller
description: A conversation that scrolls itself: opens at the end, holds a new turn near the top, follows the end, keeps your place.

name: Meter
description: A measurement within a known range — storage used, a quota, a score: a bar filled to it, the value written in the app’s language.

name: Multiselect
description: Several values from a list, an array for Signal Forms: the Combobox with several values — chips for the chosen, a search for the list.

name: Native Dialog
description: A modal dialog built on the native HTML dialog element.

name: Native Select
description: The browser's own select, in the style's look.

name: Navigation Menu
description: Site navigation with panels: opened by hover, click or keyboard; one shared box that moves between items.

name: Notification Center
description: Notifications behind a bell or in a page section: a Popover, an Item for each, a Toggle Group to filter, the state in your signals.

name: Number Group
description: A number input with its buttons: typed and read in the locale, stepped with the keyboard, buttons, the wheel or by dragging its label. In a scField, as any input; a Signal Forms control.

name: Number Ticker
description: Counting or rolling to a new value, in the reader’s language — on an SVG text too; no animation library.

name: Org Chart
description: Your people as nested lists, laid out as a chart and joined by lines; a tree for the keyboard.

name: OTP Input
description: A one-time code, one input per character, in the look of the app's style.

name: Pagination
description: Navigation controls for paging through content.

name: Password Group
description: A password input in its box, with buttons to show or hide it and to generate a strong one, on your Signal Form. In a scField, as any input; a Caps Lock warning, a strength meter and the rules met or not are parts to add.

name: PDF Viewer
description: Document viewer with navigation and zoom controls.

name: Phone Input
description: An input for international phone numbers.

name: Pie Chart
description: A series as slices of a whole, each in its category's color: a pie, a donut with your text in its center, rings.

name: Popover
description: Rich content in a panel beside its trigger — a dialog, modal or not, opened by a click or a hover, in the look of the app's style.

name: Preview Card
description: A preview of a link's destination, shown on hover or keyboard focus — in the look of the app's style.

name: Progress
description: A task's progress as a bar or a circle, named and read out, or not known yet.

name: QR Code
description: A QR code as one SVG path, named for where it leads; qrCodeToSvg and qrCodeToBlob make files.

name: Questionnaire
description: Questions one at a time on your Signal Form: checked before moving on, skipped when optional, picked by keys.

name: Radar Chart
description: Series as polygons over the categories, each on its spoke: filled or outlined, with dots, on a polygon or circle grid.

name: Radial Chart
description: A series as radial bars: a ring per row, its value as an arc — on a track, stacked, on a half circle with your text in its center.

name: Radio Group
description: A group of radio buttons for single selection.

name: Range Slider
description: A range on one track: two thumbs that never cross, in the Slider's look; the value is the pair, one Signal Forms field.

name: Rating
description: A score in stars (or any icon): a slider, whole or half stars, read out by your words; a Signal Forms field.

name: Resizable
description: Panels resized by the handles between them, by pointer or keyboard — in the look of the app's style.

name: Sankey Chart
description: Flows between nodes, each as thick as its value, the nodes in columns.

name: Scatter Chart
description: Points at two values, x and y — sized by a third: a bubble chart.

name: Scheduler
description: Events in month, week and day views, built from parts: overlapping events side by side, all-day events, now.

name: Scroll Area
description: A native scroll container with custom scrollbars — in the look of the app's style.

name: Scrollbar
description: The browser's own scrollbars in your style's look — every scrollbar of the page, from one CSS file tuned by variables; your classes win.

name: Select
description: A choice among a short list: a trigger showing the value, the options in a popup below it — a label, groups, scroll buttons, in each style's look, with Signal Forms.

name: Select On Focus
description: A directive that automatically selects input text on programmatic focus.

name: Separator
description: Visually separates content with a line.

name: Sheet
description: A dialog at the edge of the screen, sliding in from its side — in the look of the app's style.

name: Sidebar
description: A sidebar beside the page: it collapses, to icons or off the screen, and is a sheet on phones.

name: Signature Pad
description: Sign with a pen, a mouse or a finger: one part, ink that follows the pen, the strokes as a form value, exported trimmed to the ink.

name: Skeleton
description: A placeholder to show while content is loading.

name: Slider
description: A native range input, its track and thumb in the look of the app's style.

name: Sortable List
description: Your array reordered by any pointer or the keyboard, announced in your words; down, along, or as a grid.

name: Spinner
description: A loading indicator animation.

name: Stat Card
description: One figure, how it changed and whether that is good news: a Card holding a description list, its numbers written by a Number Ticker.

name: Stepper
description: Guides users through a multi-step process.

name: Sunburst Chart
description: A series in two rings: its rows' groups inside, the rows around them.

name: Switch
description: A native checkbox shown as a switch, drawn by itself, in the look of the app's style.

name: Table
description: A responsive table for displaying tabular data.

name: Table of Contents
description: The sections of a page as links, the one read marked as it scrolls.

name: Tabs
description: Tabs and their panels, one shown at a time — in the look of the app's style.

name: Tags Input
description: Tags typed into one field, a list of strings: the Combobox with several values and an Add item for the text typed.

name: Textarea
description: A multi-line text input field.

name: Theme
description: Theme management with mode switching and color scheme support.

name: Time Clock
description: A time picked on a clock face — hour, minute, second — by pointer or keyboard, each pick moving on; 12 hours with AM/PM or 24 on two rings.

name: Time Input
description: A time typed part by part, on the clock and in the order of its locale: a number pad on a phone, a Temporal.PlainTime in a form.

name: Time Picker
description: A time typed, or picked in columns — hour, minute, AM/PM — on the time input's clock and limits; a range's end shows how long.

name: Timeline
description: Dated events in order — a feed, a changelog, an order’s steps: a list for screen readers, one tab stop, the arrow keys between events.

name: Toast
description: A brief notification that appears temporarily.

name: Toggle
description: A two-state button that can be on or off.

name: Toggle Group
description: A set of toggle buttons that work together.

name: Token Input
description: A text field that holds tokens in its text — people mentioned, files attached — each moving, deleting and copying whole.

name: Toolbar
description: A container for grouping a set of controls, such as toggle buttons.

name: Tooltip
description: A short label shown on hover or keyboard focus — rich content, a group delay, in the look of the app's style.

name: Trace
description: The steps of a run — an agent's searches, reads and commands — a line each, with a status and the output it opens on.

name: Transfer List
description: One value (the chosen ids, a form field), two listbox sides, keyboard moves, search, reorder.

name: Tree
description: A hierarchical view of nested items.

name: Tree Table
description: A Data Table whose rows open on their children, as a tree grid: indented, opened by the arrows, selected with their children.

name: Treemap Chart
description: A series as boxes, each as large as its value — in groups if you like.

name: Trigger Menu
description: Suggestions as you type a trigger (@, /) in a Token Input, a textarea or an input: a list at the character; the one chosen becomes a token, or its text.

name: Typeset
description: Styles for content you don't write the markup of — rendered markdown, a chat answer — in a typeset container, and the same look for a heading, a paragraph or a quote on its own. shadcn's one CSS file, tuned by three variables; components inside keep their look, your classes win.

name: Video Player
description: A video player: controls as parts, state two ways, captions, chapters, seek preview, keyboard shortcuts.

name: Virtual List
description: Only what is seen rendered, rows measured as they render; a box or the page; down, along or in lanes.
